# Command lookup and flag errors (C3.2): every message is tmux's, and a command line that does
# not build runs nothing.
run new-session -d -s a 'exec sleep 100'
run nosuch
run ne
run kill-s
run s
run new-session -z
run new-session -d -%
run has-session -t
run has-session extra
run kill-session -t a extra
run rename-session
run has-session -?
run kill-server -?
run new-session -?
run select-pane -% -t a
run splitp -Q
run info -Q
run send-keys -t
run display-message -p -F
run set-option
run set-option -g a b c
run resize-pane -x
run has-session -t a ; nosuch
run has-session -t a ; new-session -d -s b -z
run has-session -t =a
run new-session -d -s x 'exec sleep 100' ; has-session -t nope ; kill-session -t x
run has-session -t x
run kill-session -t x
run has-session -t a\; extra
run has-session -t a \; has-session
run has-session -t a; has-session -t a;
run -- has-session
run kill-server
